title: Stable line claim says 2.2
reality: Current stable is v2.3.3 (CHANGELOG 2.3.3 'Synchronized the stable release identity as v2.3.3'); the skill's 'Honesty about the engine's limits' section opens with 'on its 2.2 stable line'.
fix: In 'Honesty about the engine's limits' change 'on its 2.2 stable line' to 'on its 2.3 stable line (2.3.3 at last sync)'.

title: '22 built-in agents' reference-table row
reality: v2.3.0 moved optional agents (Hierarchical Maps, Calls, UNO, Chess, Poker, 8-Ball Pool, Tic-Tac-Toe, RPS, Card Evolution, etc.) into downloadable packages; fresh installs contain NO optional agents; there is a 29-package official catalog (Agents → Download Agents) fed from Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents. Only Conversation's About Me profile / update_about_me stays built into the Engine.
fix: In the 'When to consult bundled references' table, change the agents row from 'Agents — the 22 built-ins, custom agents, phases...' to 'Agents — the official downloadable packages (29-package catalog via Agents → Download Agents; fresh installs ship none), custom agents, phases (pre-gen / parallel / post-proc), overriding agent prompts'.

title: 'No plugin marketplace yet' limit is wrong
reality: v2.3.0 added a full-page Agents → Download Agents library installing official capability packages from the new Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repo (29 individually verified packages: Writer, Tracker, Misc, Maps, Calls, Conversation games), with install/uninstall/update, Install All/Uninstall All, startup auto-upgrade (2.3.1), capability API 1.3 host services (2.3.2 #3690), and per-major catalog lanes (2.3.3 #3712). CSS/JS client extensions are still manually installed.
fix: Replace the limits bullet with: 'Official agent/feature packages now have a first-party catalog (Agents → Download Agents, 29 verified packages from Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents), but CSS/JS client extensions still have no marketplace — those are installed manually.'

title: Decision hierarchy lacks official-package-first step
reality: Since v2.3.0 many capabilities users might hand-build (map/state tracking via Hierarchical Maps, audio/video Calls, Music DJ, Lorebook Keeper, Illustrator, Card Evolution, table games) exist as official verified downloadable packages; Professor Mari's prompt even carries the canonical 29-package catalog summary to recommend them.
fix: Add a step to the SKILL.md decision hierarchy: 'Does an official downloadable agent package already do this? Check Agents → Download Agents (29-package catalog: Writer, Tracker, Misc, Maps, Calls, Conversation games) before building a custom agent/tool.' Mirror in the ideation anti-patterns if desired.

title: Marinara-Agents is a separate contribution surface
reality: v2.3.0 published first-party downloadable agents in the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repository, which has its own contribution rules, issue and PR templates, catalog validation, protected review flow, and automatic CodeRabbit review; agent-package work does not go through the Engine repo's PR process.
fix: In Mode B (Contribution), add a note that changes to official downloadable agent packages target github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents — a separate repo with its own rules/templates/catalog validation/CodeRabbit review — not Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Engine; route agent-package PRs and issues there and check that repo's CONTRIBUTING before scoping work.

title: New v2.3.3 env vars not documented
reality: v2.3.3 (#3730) added CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS (raises generation timeout for slow Conversation/Roleplay/Game providers) and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false (persistent launcher update opt-out on Windows/macOS/Linux/Termux without disabling manual updates). Both live in docs/CONFIGURATION.md territory.
fix: Mention CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED where the skill discusses env vars / docs/CONFIGURATION.md, so slow-provider timeout and launcher auto-update questions get correct answers.

title: Stale '2.2' version examples in fetch-triggers
reality: Current stable is 2.3.3; SKILL.md's calibration note says 'does feature X exist in 2.2 yet?' and the 'When you don't know' section says 'does 2.2.x have feature X yet?'.
fix: Update both example strings to reference 2.3.x (e.g., 'does 2.3.x have feature X yet?') so the fetch-before-answering trigger examples match the current line.

title: Calls rename and packaging in reference table
reality: v2.3.2 (#3676) renamed user-facing 'Conversation Calls' to 'Calls', and v2.3.0 moved Conversation audio/video calls into an optional downloadable package that also owns the Local Whisper model downloads (uninstalling Calls removes downloaded Whisper models).
fix: In the reference-table row 'Conversation audio/video calls, character video presence...', update wording to 'Calls (audio/video, an optional downloadable package that also owns Local Whisper models)' so answers reflect the new name and that Calls must be installed from Download Agents.

title: Version-drift section lacks current baseline
reality: At v2.3.3 Android is versionName 2.3.3 with versionCode 38 (2.3.2 was 37, 2.3.1 was 35, 2.3.0 was 34); versionCode must keep increasing monotonically from 38.
fix: In the Version drift section's Android rule, add the current baseline: 'as of v2.3.3 the shipped versionCode is 38 — the next release must use a higher code'.

title: Mari now recommends the agent catalog
reality: v2.3.0 added a canonical 29-package catalog summary to both Professor Mari prompt paths so Mari can compare and recommend every Writer, Tracker, Misc, Maps, Calls, and Conversation-game package; v2.3.2 also moved Conversation About Me drafting from per-editor AI Write to Professor Mari.
fix: Extend the 'In-app shortcut' callout: note that as of 2.3 Mari can also compare/recommend the official downloadable agent packages and now handles Conversation About Me bio drafting directly (saving to the real About Me field).

title: Q5 custom agents: no catalog check or Enable Agents note
reality: v2.3.0 shipped official downloadable Tracker/Writer/Misc packages (e.g., Hierarchical Maps is a Tracker Agent, Card Evolution a Writer Agent) covering common per-turn jobs; and since 2.3.2 (#3692) custom agents run in Conversation/Roleplay/Game only when the per-chat 'Enable Agents' master toggle is on (2.3.3 made Maps obey it too).
fix: In Question 5, add: (a) 'Before building a custom agent, check Agents → Download Agents — an official package (e.g., Hierarchical Maps for location/state tracking, Card Evolution, Music DJ, Lorebook Keeper) may already do the job'; (b) note that all agent execution is gated by the chat's Enable Agents master toggle.

title: Q8 media generation now requires Illustrator package
reality: v2.3.0 renamed Visual Generation to Illustrator, renamed selfie configuration to Illustrator Settings, renamed the Connections defaults category to Images, and gated the surfaces: Gallery Illustrate/Selfie/Storyboard/Video/Animate/Background actions and the /illustrate and /selfie commands appear only when the Illustrator package is installed and enabled for that chat, in every mode.
fix: Update Question 8: keep 'not a webhook', but state that image/video generation is provided by the official Illustrator agent package (install via Agents → Download Agents) plus an image/video connection (Connections defaults category is now 'Images'); mention the renames and that Gallery/slash-command surfaces stay hidden until Illustrator is installed and enabled.

title: Game mode bullet missing Tactical Combat and setup bundles
reality: v2.3.0 added a Game-mode Combat Preference (setup wizard + Chat Settings → Combat Style): classic narrative combat or a tactical grid-based battle style with terrain battlefields, unit classes, movement/attack ranges, deterministic seeded enemy phase at four difficulty levels. v2.3.2 (#3701) added reusable versioned .marinara-game-setup.json export/import bundles that refill the New Game wizard.
fix: In the mode-selection section's Game bullet, add: '(v2.3) choose a Combat Preference — classic narrative or tactical grid-based battles — and Game setups can be exported/imported as versioned .marinara-game-setup.json bundles.'

title: Q8 'Conversation-call video presence' assumes built-in Calls
reality: v2.3.0 moved Conversation audio/video calls into the optional downloadable Calls package (renamed from 'Conversation Calls' in 2.3.2 #3676); call surfaces and Local Whisper models exist only when the package is installed.
fix: In Question 8's surface list, mark 'Conversation-call video presence' as requiring the Calls package (installed via Agents → Download Agents).

title: Noodle bullet omits editable Noodle Prompt
reality: v2.3.0 added an editable Noodle Prompt at the top of Noodle Settings (full-screen editor, one-click default restoration) plus a default-on setting excluding Professor Mari from Noodle discovery (#3598) — the primary customization surface for Noodle personas.
fix: Append to the Noodle mode bullet: 'As of v2.3 the Noodle system prompt is user-editable in Noodle Settings (with default restoration), and Professor Mari is excluded from timeline discovery by default.'
